messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: Good news for once :tada: unity_video_retarget CPI has dropped from ~$1.15 to $0.48 yesterday. Installs more than doubled (2.2k -> 5.8k/day) on the same budget. I think Unity's new video placements finally kicked in. Proposing +50% budget on it from tomorrow.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Wow. Is it all three creatives or just one?

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: All three, roughly the same. UNT-VID-03 maybe a bit more. Asking creative if anything changed.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Before we pour money in: a 2.5x efficiency jump overnight on a retargeting campaign is unusual. @Ingrid Solberg can you look at CTR / CVR / D1 for this campaign before we scale?

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Posted in #data-questions. Short version: CTR went from 1.6% to ~8%, click->install CVR halved, and D1 retention of the new cohorts is ~15% vs ~34% before. Spend didn't change. This looks like click spam / install fraud, not a better placement. Please don't scale.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Ugh. OK, that kills it. Budget stays flat, opening a ticket with Unity.
